title: A Message in the Morning
text:
Maria sends a text message to her friend Ana every morning. Today she writes, "Are you free this afternoon?" Ana does not answer for an hour because she is at work. Maria is a little worried, so she sends another message.

When Ana finally reads the messages, she laughs. She replies, "Sorry! My phone was in my bag. Yes, let's meet at the café at three." Maria is happy and sends a smiley face.

questions.text: Who does Maria send a text message to every morning?
What time do Maria and Ana plan to meet?
Why did Ana not answer Maria's first message for an hour?
options: She did not want to meet her friend.
She was busy at work and could not check her phone.

questions.text: How does Maria probably feel at the end of the story?

vocabulary.definition: feeling anxious about something that might go wrong
the part of the day between noon and evening
to answer a message or question

paragraph_translations: Maria envia uma mensagem de texto para a amiga Ana todas as manhãs. Hoje ela escreve: "Você está livre esta tarde?" Ana não responde durante uma hora porque está no trabalho. Maria fica um pouco preocupada, então envia outra mensagem.
Quando Ana finalmente lê as mensagens, ela ri. Ela responde: "Desculpe! Meu telefone estava na bolsa. Sim, vamos nos encontrar no café às três." Maria fica feliz e envia um emoji sorridente.
